verdicts.why: The check asserts that an equal ArtifactPointer publish retry returns the same pointer and version without changing the store or creating another pointer, including after that pointer becomes superseded. It does not cover Project, Customer, or Room request-id behavior, nor refusal when the pointer's project is archived.
